name: useGPU
summary: Which GPU this is, and whether your frames are arriving on time.
plain: Identifies the graphics chip and measures how smoothly the interface is drawing. If animations feel rough, this tells you whether frames are actually being missed and by how much.
description: The renderer, vendor and OpenGL version are read through a real offscreen EGL context; the Vulkan version comes from the android.hardware.vulkan.version system feature. Frame timing is measured on the UI thread with Choreographer in one-second windows: average and worst frame interval, frames presented per second, and a jank count for frames that took more than 1.5x the expected interval. Android does not expose GPU memory usage to apps, so that field is always null rather than estimated.

returns.name: gpuRenderer
returns.desc: GPU name from the driver. Null until the EGL context has been created.

returns.name: graphicsApi
returns.desc: OpenGL ES version and, where present, the Vulkan version.

returns.name: frameRenderTimeMs
returns.desc: Average gap between presented frames over the last second. Compare against targetBudgetMs.

returns.name: maxFrameMs
returns.desc: Worst single frame in that window, which is what a user actually perceives as a stutter.

returns.name: measuredFps
returns.desc: Frames actually presented per second, not the display mode.

returns.name: droppedFrameCount
returns.desc: Running total of janky frames since the hook mounted.

returns.name: jankFramesLastSecond
returns.desc: Janky frames in the most recent window only.

returns.name: targetBudgetMs
returns.desc: Time available per frame at the current refresh rate: 8.33 ms at 120 Hz, 16.67 ms at 60 Hz.

returns.name: isStuttering
returns.desc: True when the average frame is running more than 1.5x over budget.

returns.name: gpuMemoryUsageMB
returns.desc: Always null. Android does not expose this to apps.

returns.name: source
returns.desc: Where the numbers came from. There is no 'simulated' value: a reading is real, derived from real readings, or unavailable.

agentNote: Check isStuttering before adding animation work. Frame timing measures the UI thread, so heavy JS shows up here even when the GPU is idle.
